notes.title: An upcoming Event?
notes.content:
[h1][b]A Change in Price[/b][/h1]
[h2]Hello fellow visual novel lovers!
Since the game hasn't been doing well on the paid way, We've decided to make it free as a gift to you all. Consider it as a birthday gift from us. Sorry for those who have paid the entire $0.79, but as of now, the best way is to make this game free...[/h2]

[h2]That's all from us. Thanks and sorry to bring it to y'all.
- Team NTZ[/h2]
